purpose: Prepare a slow, serial, read-only Xiaohongshu evidence query for the named building compound and map blockers. This is not evidence collection or a map decision.

included: Fahuazhen Road and Dingxi Road curb, width, surface and access controls
entrance sequence and independently locatable controls
legal Hero and Identity lineage evidence requirements
excluded: browser or Xiaohongshu access in this preparation task
Blender, MCP, generator, GLB or Blend changes
shared registry, runtime, Fast Mode, exact-status or roster changes
trees, decorations, ordinary OSM and full-map assets

recoveryCleanV2Massing.policy: read-only; do not rebuild or rerun accepted runtime visibility

isolatedMassingV3.policy: retain candidate; no new model work is authorized by this contract

legacyHero.policy: retain file; never present it as a legal Hero or derive Identity from it

knownControls.courtyard: locally observed as open, but exact polygon, entrances and bounding members are unknown

fahuazhenRoad.requiredEvidence: measured or authoritative curb/surface cross-section and access classification at nearest footprint point

dingxiRoad.requiredEvidence: curb/surface and access confirmation only; it is not the current overlap blocker

prohibitedInference: operator or government service-page floor area is not a footprint
conflicting 5428.17 and over-10000 square metre statements cannot set scale
a compound photo cannot assign a named facade to one OSM way without independently locatable controls
the -0.633229 overlap cannot be solved by moving, shrinking, clipping the building or narrowing shared road width

queries: 上海 德必法华525 园区 总平面
法华镇路525号 德必 园区 入口 庭院
德必法华525 建筑群 院落
accept: one post contains a continuous, locatable sequence from signed entrance through courtyard to distinguishable built masses
at least two independent visual anchors connect the sequence to 525 or a uniquely visible adjacent road/landmark
open ground is visibly separated from roofed building volume
reject: front-facade repost with no route or context
photos of nearby Fahua heritage, Shanghai Orchestra or unrelated Dobe campuses

queries: 法华镇路525号 路口 路缘
德必法华525 法华镇路 街景
德必法华525 定西路 入口
accept: road edge and building/compound edge are visible in one unambiguously locatable view
a stable physical control such as street sign, entrance number, junction, curb line or facade is visible
if a width is inferred from a photograph it is labelled inferred and never used alone to alter runtime road width
reject: cropped road or driveway images without address/landmark controls
maps, navigation screenshots or author captions presented as surveyed geometry
views that cannot distinguish Fahuazhen Road from Dingxi Road
doesNotProve: permission to change shared road contract

queries: 德必法华525 入口 外立面
上海 法华镇路525号 主楼 外置楼梯
德必法华525 白色竖框 楼梯
accept: the six-storey white vertical-frame facade and external switchback stair are visible with address or compound controls
a second perspective establishes entrance-to-facade or facade-to-courtyard relation
new evidence is sufficient to write observed/inferred/unknown separately
reject: AI-rendered, heavily filtered or source-untraceable image
logo, sign or floor-area text alone
legacy Hero render presented as a real photo
doesNotAuthorize: Hero creation before formal Massing map acceptance and MCP1
Identity derivation from legacy scope-polluted Hero

acceptanceMatrix.compoundMemberBinding: requires a primary plan or multiple independently locatable ground-level views that associate target facade, courtyard and included/excluded masses; Xiaohongshu alone remains corroboration unless controls are decisive
acceptanceMatrix.courtyardFootprint: requires visible open-space boundaries at two or more controlled views plus an authoritative/georeferenced plan before an exact polygon decision
acceptanceMatrix.fahuazhenRoadWidth: requires measured or authoritative cross-section/surface edge; image-only evidence may flag a discrepancy but cannot narrow the shared road
acceptanceMatrix.entrance: requires address/compound control and continuity into the target building or courtyard
acceptanceMatrix.heroIdentityLineage: only after main window accepts one Massing source, passes MCP1 and formal map gate; then build a pure-building Hero, pass MCP2 and derive Identity from frozen Hero SHA

permittedActions: open one result at a time
record directly visible text and media facts with URL and collection time
forbiddenActions: likes, follows, comments, saves or messages
simulating human behavior to bypass detection
slowSerialOperation.postStopPolicy: record not-run or partial-run with reason; do not retry in the same session

disposition.reasonableMissMayBeConfirmedBy: main window only, after this exact serial contract has been executed without a platform warning and its logged results fail the acceptance matrix
disposition.runtimeDisable: candidate-only after main-window reasonable-miss adjudication; this contract neither requests nor performs it
disposition.retention: all existing GLB, Blend, generator, evidence, Recovery/Hold and held candidates remain permanently retained regardless of a later runtime-disable decision
